claims.quote: This is done by making the hours of labor in different trades to differ according to their arduousness.
claims.description: Work hours vary by trade, with arduous trades having shorter hours so that they attract volunteers.

claims.quote: It is the grade to which all new recruits belong for the first three years of their service.
claims.description: Every new recruit serves three years as a common laborer before choosing a trade.

claims.quote: remains open to every man till the age of thirty is reached
claims.description: Free professional training is open to any man until age thirty.

claims.quote: The nation does not maim and slaughter its workmen by thousands, as did the private capitalists and corporations of your day.
claims.description: The state guarantees workplace safety, so mass industrial accidents end.

claims.quote: Since the nation is the sole employer, the government must fix the rate of wages and determine just how much everybody shall earn, from the doctors to the diggers.
claims.description: A government sets wages for every occupation because it is the only employer.

claims.quote: A credit corresponding to his share of the annual product of the nation is given to every citizen on the public books at the beginning of each year
claims.description: Each citizen receives an annual credit equal to a share of national output, spent at public storehouses.

claims.quote: A system of direct distribution from the national storehouses took the place of trade, and for this money was unnecessary.
claims.description: Goods are distributed directly from national storehouses, so trade and money are no longer needed.

claims.quote: According to our ideas, buying and selling is essentially anti-social in all its tendencies.
claims.description: Buying and selling are considered antisocial and are no longer practiced.

claims.quote: No man any more has any care for the morrow, either for himself or his children, for the nation guarantees the nurture, education, and comfortable maintenance of every citizen from the cradle to the grave.
claims.description: The state guarantees each citizen's upbringing, education and support from birth to death, so no one saves.

claims.quote: Suppose a board of fairly sensible men were charged with settling the wages for all sorts of trades under a system which, like ours, guaranteed employment to all, while permitting the choice of avocations.
claims.description: A board of appointed men sets wages for every trade, and wage imbalances correct themselves through volunteering.

claims.quote: my waking to find myself in the year 2000
claims.description: A man from 1887 wakes up in the year 2000.

claims.quote: burglary was not among the perils of the modern Boston
claims.description: Crime is so rare that houses are left unlocked.

claims.quote: But what surprised me as much as anything was not to find any stores on Washington Street, or any banks on State.
claims.description: Retail stores and banks no longer operate in the city center.

claims.quote: As to the bankers, having no money we have no use for those gentry.
claims.description: Banks and bankers are unnecessary because money has been abolished.

claims.quote: I know, as well as I know that the world now is heaven compared with what it was in your day
claims.description: The world of 2000 is far better than the nineteenth century.
